column.text: Haaland scored 2, so his armband returned 4 for the 76 managers who trusted him, and the league's running joke rolls on. The title race is tight and the Haaland sulk continues.

preview.headline: Gameweek 11: Neol and Rajat Arora on a knife edge

points.label: Title race
points.text: Rajat Arora leads Neol by 18 points, so Neol needs a big week to close the gap before it grows further.

points.label: Armband dilemma
points.text: Haaland blanked for 76 managers, but Isak and Gabriel each returned 16 on the armband. Will the rebels switch?

points.label: Injury sweat
points.text: Thomas is 75% to play and João Pedro is ruled out, with 12 managers owning him. Check your bench.

points.label: Chips loaded
points.text: Several managers still hold their Free Hit, Wildcard and Triple Captain, so expect some chip fireworks.

storylines.title: Haaland armband fiasco
storylines.text: Haaland scored 2, so 4 for each of his 92 captains. Rebels who ignored him are gloating.

storylines.title: Title race at the top
storylines.text: Rajat Arora leads Neol by 19 points, with Barry the only one left for the leader.

storylines.title: Big prize scramble
storylines.text: Biswadeep and Prathap sit in the Big prizes with Cherag just 5 back. The chasing pack is tight.

plots.title: Biswadeep's Slide Begins
plots.text: Biswadeep now sits 9th of 113, having started GW1 in 85th, a climb of 76 places. Last week's 6th-place finish has slipped, so the top-5 push has stalled for now.
plots.next: Biswadeep could rebound into the top 5 if the next few gameweeks go his way.
plots.question: How high can Biswadeep go?

plots.title: Arora's Lead Holds
plots.text: Rajat Arora leads Neol 759 to 740, a gap of 19 after growing from 18 last gameweek. He has now topped the table for 5 weeks in a row, with Sukrut 23 points back in third.
plots.next: If Arora's lead shrinks, Neol or Sukrut could make the top spot a real contest.
plots.question: Can anyone stop Rajat Arora?

plots.title: Nanik Snatches Back Lead
plots.text: Nanik now leads Sahil by just 1 point, after Sahil was 9 points ahead last gameweek. The 2 have swapped places 9 times this season.
plots.next: One result could flip this rivalry again, so Sahil has a chance to reply.
plots.question: Nanik v Sahil: who blinks first?

plots.title: Biswadeep Takes The Last Spot
plots.text: Biswadeep now holds the final big-prize place, 5 points ahead of Cherag. Cherag has spent 3 of the last 5 gameweeks in the zone, while Biswadeep has managed 2.
plots.next: Cherag could fight back for the 9th spot if results go their way.
plots.question: Who holds the last big-prize place?

plots.title: Cherag Leads The Champions
plots.text: Cherag remains the best-placed former champion in 10th, with 2 titles. Kunaal, who has 4 titles, is 49th, while Zorawar sits 36th and Bhavin 34th.

piece.headline: ARORA STRETCHES CLEAR AS HAALAND FLOPS
piece.standfirst: Haaland blanked on 76 armbands, yet the leader still grew his lead. Kartik took the week.
piece.big_picture: Another Haaland blank, and still Rajat Arora pulled further clear. 4 weeks on top and the lead is now 18. Neol keeps second, but the chasing pack is not closing. Arora keeps getting free runs.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Swapnil picked the wrong 11 and the bench ate a big chunk of a good week. Imagine the score if the right players had started.
piece.one_to_watch: Prathap holds the last big-prize place, with Cherag just 2 points behind. If Cherag's bench stops biting, the spot could change hands in a single week.

title.title: Arora Stretches Clear
title.text: Rajat Arora leads Neol 734 to 716, a gap of 18 after it grew from 16 last gameweek. Third-placed Aryan Khamankar sits 27 points off the top, and Arora has now led for 4 weeks running.
title.next: If Arora's lead keeps growing, the chasing pack may need a major swing to catch up.

title.title: Arora's Lead Holds
title.text: Rajat Arora leads Neol 759 to 740, a gap of 19 after growing from 18 last gameweek. He has now topped the table for 5 weeks in a row, with Sukrut 23 points back in third.
title.next: If Arora's lead shrinks, Neol or Sukrut could make the top spot a real contest.

underdog:4722308.title: Biswadeep Keeps Rising
underdog:4722308.text: Biswadeep has climbed from 85th in GW1 to 6th of 113 managers, a rise of 79 places. The move from 11th to 6th in the last week puts a top-5 finish within reach.
underdog:4722308.next: If the climb continues, Biswadeep could break into the top 5 before the season ends.

underdog:4722308.title: Biswadeep's Slide Begins
underdog:4722308.text: Biswadeep now sits 9th of 113, having started GW1 in 85th, a climb of 76 places. Last week's 6th-place finish has slipped, so the top-5 push has stalled for now.
underdog:4722308.next: Biswadeep could rebound into the top 5 if the next few gameweeks go his way.

chase:18991.title: Arshad closes in fast
chase:18991.text: Arshad has cut Adrian's lead from 48 in GW7 to 39, then 24, and now just 2. Adrian is still ahead, but the chase has never been closer.

gold.title: Prathap Holds The Line
gold.text: Prathap is the last manager inside the top 9, with Cherag first out just 2 points behind. Cherag has spent 4 of the last 5 gameweeks in the zone, while Prathap has spent only one.
gold.next: Cherag could edge back into the top 9 and push Prathap out of the final place.

gold.title: Biswadeep Takes The Last Spot
gold.text: Biswadeep now holds the final big-prize place, 5 points ahead of Cherag. Cherag has spent 3 of the last 5 gameweeks in the zone, while Biswadeep has managed 2.
gold.next: Cherag could fight back for the 9th spot if results go their way.

champions.title: Cherag's Title Chance
champions.text: Cherag is the best-placed former champion, sitting 10th with 2 titles from 2018-19 and 2015-16. Kunaal has 4 titles but is 56th, while Zorawar and Bhavin are 36th and 33rd.
champions.next: Cherag could climb further and turn a top-10 place into a real push for the title.

champions.title: Cherag Leads The Champions
champions.text: Cherag remains the best-placed former champion in 10th, with 2 titles. Kunaal, who has 4 titles, is 49th, while Zorawar sits 36th and Bhavin 34th.
champions.next: Cherag could push further up the table, but the other former champions have a long way to climb.

chase:3991082.title: Sukrut Closes to 3
chase:3991082.text: Sukrut trails Yash Bhatia by just 3 points after GW10, down from 60 in GW7. The gap has shrunk every week since, with 37 in GW8 and 18 in GW9.
chase:3991082.next: If Sukrut overtakes Yash next week, the chase ends and the lead changes hands.

slump:10615.title: Maanas Searches For Form
slump:10615.text: Maanas has been below the league average for 6 weeks in a row. After a low of 42 in GW8, points rose to 52 and then 55 in GW10.
slump:10615.next: Another strong week could start a recovery, but another dip would deepen the slump.

slump:10615.title: Maanas Starts To Recover
slump:10615.text: Maanas has been below the league average for 6 weeks in a row. Points have recovered from a low of 42 in GW8 to 55 in GW10, but the slump continues.
slump:10615.next: A score above the league average could be the first real sign that the slump is ending.

rivalry:107315-780469.title: Sahej And Sahil Level
rivalry:107315-780469.text: Sahej and Sahil are level on points in GW10, after Sahej led by 17 a week earlier. They have swapped places 6 times this season, so the rivalry remains wide open.
rivalry:107315-780469.next: Whoever makes the next move could take control of this rivalry.

rivalry:780469-1541394.title: Nanik Snatches Back Lead
rivalry:780469-1541394.text: Nanik now leads Sahil by just 1 point, after Sahil was 9 points ahead last gameweek. The 2 have swapped places 9 times this season.
